reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing link-precondition pattern: a new ensureAccountIsOpen in link.ts beside ensureAccountNotLinked, called from each provider handler the same way.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; the six one-line call sites mirror the existing per-handler ensureAccountNotLinked calls, since the tree has no shared link pipeline to host it.

placement.why: Precondition lives in accounts/link.ts with the other link guards and runs before findOrCreateBank in every handler.

scope.why: Only the guard, its calls and unit tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, well-named guard, though a future provider must remember to call it alongside ensureAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts ensureAccountIsOpen defines the closed-account rule once; every *-accounts-link handler in accounts/app.ts (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking, fintegra) calls it.
